name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands two things — open the door, and pick up the target box — as two independent sentences with no order word linking them. The hard Existence(door_open) and hard Existence(target_picked_up) capture exactly these goals; neither is redundant (neither forces the other), and no order clause is added or missing.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the target box at least once.
machine:

(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
